Hunter Biden is willing to testify PUBLICLY in front of the @GOPOversight Committee, yet they just voted to recommend that the House holds him in contempt.

Today I used my time to highlight the Chairman's selective treatment of the facts and unveil this sham—because the truth of the matter is that this has all been a waste of time.

Don’t forget! Affordable, reliable health care coverage is STILL available at https://t.co/42tI5X5V2n. The #ACA marketplaces are more affordable than ever for Floridians. 

Open enrollment ends on January 16, for 2024 health coverage! https://t.co/0QSIWid8BE

Make no mistake—throwing folks experiencing homelessness in jail or fining them for sleeping outside only makes homelessness worse. Today's ruling sets a dangerous precedent for every American who has no choice but to sleep outside and the millions of families who are one missed paycheck away from homelessness.

In the face of this ruling, we must focus on housing, NOT handcuffs. I will continue the fight to bring more federal dollars to our Central FL community, like the millions of dollars I've brought home to create more affordable housing. But at the end of the day, it’s transformative solutions that will best crack the housing crisis, like my bill, which would end renter junk fees and credit checks in the rental process.

☀️ It's a hot one today! Central FL is under a heat advisory til 6 PM today. Limit strenuous outdoor activities and take action when you see symptoms of heat exhaustion and heat stroke.

For more tips on staying safe in the heat, visit https://t.co/Xu5ax6vJt8

The Biden-Harris Administration and Democrats made Medicare stronger and are saving American seniors thousands on Rx drugs. Don’t wait to get the coverage you need: Medicare Open Enrollment runs now until December 7. 

Visit https://t.co/KKDxZZGkSp to get started. https://t.co/Cjwg9AyM1E

‼️ACA enrollment ends in just two day on Dec. 15! Thanks to the Biden Administration, 80% of Americans who get health coverage through the ACA marketplace can access a plan for $120 or less per year. Enroll now for coverage starting Jan. 1 at https://t.co/5luaMqHRy7

I’ll never forget watching the news coverage filled with terrified faces of families and parents waiting for their child or loved one to be one of the lucky few to walk out of Sandy Hook Elementary in December of 2012. The 26 victims deserve to be alive today. They deserved to be safe in that elementary school. I’ll never forget them, and in their honor I will never give up in the fight for a world without gun violence.

🍽️ From June 2 to July 25, children and young adults under 18 can get a free meal from Orange County Public Schools Food & Nutrition Services at one of their pop-up branches around Central FL. Learn more below!
https://t.co/WlziO295xL

16 million Americans will lose their healthcare coverage under Trump's Big Ugly Bill. That's 16 million lives needlessly put at risk of medical bankruptcy, hospitalization, and death.

This bill is immoral, and so is every single member of Congress that votes for it. https://t.co/yRyTug3aTO

House Republicans jammed through a reckless bill that slashes Medicaid, raises costs, and forces hospitals to close — all while leaving town with a shutdown looming. If the government shuts down, Republicans own it. 

Families deserve better than this and I will fight like hell to protect their healthcare.
https://t.co/P1fbEiWVVT

Government funding runs out tomorrow and Republicans are pushing a partisan bill that will cause health care costs to skyrocket.

If ACA tax credits aren’t protected, 20 million Americans will see their premiums soar — including 189,000 Central Floridians.

I won’t back any bill that drives up your costs.

This shutdown fight is about Central Floridians like Rachel.

Her family relies on the Affordable Care Act — but Republicans’ healthcare crisis would make it so Rachel's family could no longer afford their premiums.

I’ll keep fighting for families like hers & holding the line. https://t.co/RCEqSmXu1j

It’s Day 7 of the Republican government shutdown.

Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress created a health care crisis that’s driving up premiums for families, including 189,000 in Central Florida.

I won't stop fighting against their plan to raise your healthcare costs. https://t.co/PEdK4Yg1yM

Trump and Republicans in Congress shut the government down to push their partisan budget that would raise monthly healthcare costs for millions of Americans.

I asked Central Floridians how the Republican healthcare crisis would impact them, here's what they said: https://t.co/3Fjwt2MqEk

I met with Central FL seniors to talk about what the Republican government shutdown and health care crisis means for them. 

The reality? Premiums are skyrocketing for over 100K Floridians. Republicans need to end this shutdown and I'll keep fighting to protect your care. https://t.co/TaIrYXayW7

Millions of Americans — including 189,000 Central Floridians — are facing higher health care premiums because Republicans shut down the government and left town.

Democrats are ready to reopen the government and protect healthcare. Republicans need to get back to work. https://t.co/p5jcpY1J21

The CEO of Citizens Property Insurance sent me a nasty letter because I’ve raised concerns about Floridians being forced into arbitration to dispute insurance claims. Once again, my concern, as shown by the data, is that Floridians are being denied valid claims. https://t.co/ZlzBRhblSS
Just for the record… @Grok, why would an insurance company use forced arbitration in handling a claim dispute?

Day 11 of the Republican shutdown.

House Republicans canceled votes AGAIN while families across the country & in Central Florida are receiving letters saying their healthcare costs are skyrocketing.

Republicans might be on vacation, but I’ll keep fighting to protect your care. https://t.co/6LGKGuigum

It’s week two of the Republican shutdown. 

House Democrats are here in D.C. to protect your healthcare and fight for federal workers. 

Where are House Republicans? https://t.co/zWXa7yLk2p

Millions of seniors and others lost access to virtual care when Medicare’s COVID-era tele health waivers expired Oct. 1.

Congress could have extended this lifeline. Instead, Trump and MAGA Republicans shut the government down. https://t.co/lfiBOopaSU

Families are getting letters right now that their health insurance premiums are doubling, and for working people—this is life-changing. 

The fight to reopen the government and lower health care costs isn’t about politics. It’s about making sure everyone can afford the care they deserve.

Federal workers are showing up every day — even without pay — while Trump and Republicans in Congress hold the government hostage to attack your healthcare.

I’m fighting to end this shutdown, support federal workers, and protect the care you deserve. https://t.co/FtjatOheYc

Across the country and in Central Florida, people are opening letters saying their health care premiums are skyrocketing — while Republicans keep the government shut down.

I’ll keep fighting to end the shutdown and protect your health care. https://t.co/BC4BfApjjh
Have you or your family been impacted by the Republican healthcare crisis? Share your story with me at https://t.co/ZPLc7micxL
